name: page
title: New Page
description: Creates a React page with an addressable root construction seat for applying a grid layout and inserting components.

settings.name: title
settings.title: Title
settings.description: Optional display title for the generated React page; defaults to its name.

settings.name: description
settings.title: Description
settings.description: Optional description for the generated React page.

settings.name: indexed
settings.title: Include in Index
settings.description: Whether the generated item should appear in its project manifest.

settings.name: location
settings.title: Pages Location
settings.description: Optional pages folder. Defaults to the loaded project's configured pages path or src/pages.

settings.name: content
settings.title: Initial Content
settings.description: Default text; supplied children take precedence.

settings.name: transmitting
settings.title: Transmitting
settings.description: Omit to use the signal template default.
